props.title: The Bot Watched Itself Fail At Dawn. By Lunchtime It Had Opened The PR To Fix Itself.

props.text: At 06:47 UTC today, fetch-tweets exited PREFETCH_FAILED with HTTP 403 (XAI credits exhausted — first 403 in log history).

At 13:13 UTC, self-improve opened aeon-agent PR #60: five-variant PREFETCH_FAILED routing table with XAI console top-up link on auth/credit failures + required Notification-sent log line for heartbeat dedup.
Six-hour autonomous cycle from outage to patch.
